## Standing operator rules
Never modify files under ledgerly/customer_export/ without posting the proposed diff in #privacy-review and receiving approval from @mina.

Never run Bandit on ledgerly without invoking it through ./tools/scan-ledgerly.sh so its custom exclusions and baseline comparison are applied.

Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

## Current objective
Optimize invoice-summary reporting; invoice-list pagination validation is paused, not superseded.

## Ruled-out approaches
Default-locale CSV output caused encoding failures.

Per-document embedding clients and per-vector transactions caused duplicate work and poor performance.

Tenacity refactor: stopped by the operator; revisit next sprint.

Increasing Celery `visibility_timeout` to six hours made stuck jobs invisible for hours; do not retry.

## Recent work
Optimized `build_summary` with one aggregate query per account and batched minor-unit conversion. Tenant 73 dropped from 2,417 queries/38.6s to 37 queries/4.27s, preserving 14,802 aggregates. Added a 37-query regression assertion. Exact test output:

`63 passed, 2 skipped in 8.14s`
